data.one_liner: Verify emails using an OTP-based method with a custom or default server.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter package that allows developers to verify that a provided email is valid and existing by sending and validating an OTP. It supports both a default test server (with limitations) and custom production servers.
use_when: You need to verify user email ownership via OTP during registration or login
You want to connect to a custom backend node server for email verification
avoid_when: You are using a fully managed auth provider like Firebase Auth that handles email verification out of the box
You require advanced multi-factor authentication beyond simple email OTP
strengths: Easy setup for sending and validating OTPs with minimal parameters
Supports custom server configurations for production use
Includes enriched log messages for debugging
weaknesses: Test server has a strict limitation of 30 mails
Requires setting up and hosting an external Node server for production use
data.setup_notes: Requires instantiating EmailAuth and optionally configuring a remote server URL and key.

alternatives.name: firebase_auth
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides built-in email verification and comprehensive authentication features without requiring a custom backend.

data.minimal_example:
EmailAuth emailAuth = new EmailAuth(sessionName: "Sample session");
bool result = await emailAuth.sendOtp(recipientMail: _emailController.value.text, otpLength: 5);
